breadth.definition: % of eligible active Binance USDT perpetual symbols trading above their 30-week proxy moving average.
breadth.eligible_rule: Active on date and at least 210 daily closes available.

lifecycle.delist_rule: Symbol remains in historical calculations until its inferred delist date and is excluded afterwards.
lifecycle.listing_rule: Inferred from earliest available daily bar, first observed active snapshot, and onboard date when available.
lifecycle.survivorship_bias: Historical breadth respects symbol lifecycle intervals instead of today's universe.
